title: Binance Will Add Space and Time (SXT) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Space and Time (SXT)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin  and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn SXT Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-05-08 13:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Limited-time offer for new Earn users:  66% APR SXT Locked Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-05-12 02:00 (UTC) , available on  a first-come, first-served basis . Details as follow: Digital Asset Duration Special APR Min. Subscription Limit per User Max. Subscription Limit per User Max. Total Subscription Limit SXT 3 days 66% 1 SXT 500 SXT 600,000 SXT Please note: Only users who have  never  subscribed to Simple Earn Locked Products before   2025-05-08 13:00 (UTC)  can view this special offer.  It may  take up to 24 hours  before newly registered users can see and subscribe to the special offer.  Binance Simple Earn will redeem the digital assets/digital currencies subscribed to Simple Earn Locked Products to Flexible Products at the end of the agreed subscription period. Please refer to  Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions  and  Risk Warning  for more information prior to using Simple Earn. For more information, please check the  Locked Products FAQ . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  SXT  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Revolut  or buy and sell  SXT  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  SXT  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  SXT  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  SXT  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  SXT  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  SXT/USDT  and  SXT/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-05-08 13:20 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will convert the USDⓈ-M SXT Perpetual Contract pre-market trading to standard  USDⓈ-M SXT Perpetual Contract  at  2025-05-08 13:00 (UTC) . The transition period  may take up to 1 hour . SXTUSDT perpetual trading and existing positions will  not  be affected during the transition period. More details on the USDⓈ-M SXT Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below: USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract SXTUSDT Launch Time  2025-05-08 13:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset Space and Time (SXT) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 5x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  Pre-market Standard Perpetual Transition Period : Pre-market perpetual futures contracts will be converted to standard perpetual futures contracts when a stable index price can be derived from the spot market (as determined by Binance). The mark price will gradually converge from pre-market trading Mark Price to the standard Mark Price during the transition period, calculation as below: Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price)  Trading function is not affected during the transition period. Open orders and positions will not be cancelled. Mark Price After the Pre-Market Trading Ends:  When a pre-market perpetual futures contract ends, the Mark Price will be calculated using the following formula: Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) The maximum funding rate of the SXTUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2025-05-08 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-08 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-09 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-09 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … The aforementioned perpetual contract will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this FAQ . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the SXTUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the SXTUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the SXTUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The SXTUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Binance Team 2025-05-08 Note: This announcement was updated on 2025-05-08 to update the listing time of Earn’s special 66% APR SXT Locked Products will be postponed to 2025-05-12 02:00 (UTC).
